title: feat(plugin-form): the form dialog maximizes in place like the record drawer, remembered per object
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU5y97XtBcJ8qSLSR3B3Djd)_
Fixes #34604
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgwLiKcfujYUug7sPs

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新建 / 编辑表单弹窗的标题栏加了放大 / 还原按钮（和记录抽屉同一个图标、同一个位置，紧挨关闭按钮左边）；普通表单和带行项目的表单两种弹窗都有，并按对象记住上次的选择。
- 为什么改：长表单、带行项目的报价单在弹窗里只能用 90% 高度、受限宽度；维护者要求「展开为整页，现在右侧弹出框已经有放大缩小的图标，可以统一风格」。
- 风险与回滚：只改弹窗外框的 class，表单本身不重新挂载，已填内容、未保存提示、行项目都保留；回滚即还原本 PR，选择记录在浏览器 localStorage（键 `modal-form-maximized:OBJECT`），无数据或元数据改动。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`（`effectiveModalSize` 里的放大覆盖、`heightClass`、`maximizeButton`）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/modalMaximize.ts`（按对象记忆）、`__tests__/modalMaximize-34604.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：控制台打开「新建商机」，填两个字段后点标题栏右上角关闭按钮左边的放大图标：弹窗铺满、内容还在；再点还原回原尺寸；关掉重开同一对象仍是放大状态，换一个对象是原尺寸。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- The form dialog (`ModalForm`) draws the record drawer's maximize / restore switch in its header: the same `RecordTopBarButton`, the lucide `Maximize2` / `Minimize2` pair at `h-3.5 w-3.5`, the same existing i18n keys (`detail.maximize` / `detail.restoreSize`), placed just before the close (X) button in both position and tab order. Both arms carry it: the flat form and the `subforms` master-detail form (its own `MobileDialogContent`).
- Maximized, the effective size is `full` (`sm:max-w-[95vw]`) whatever the authored or inferred size, and the height cap is lifted: `sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[90vh]` becomes `sm:h-[95dvh] sm:max-h-[95dvh]`, so the dialog fills the window and its body scroller (not the page) scrolls a long form. Restore puts back the exact previous classes.
- Toggling changes the content element's classes only. The form subtree is not remounted: typed values, the dirty state that arms the discard guard, and master-detail lines all survive (pinned by element identity).
- Every reader of the size reads the effective size, so `dialogUndeclaredColumns(fieldCount, modalSize)` (#34607) answers four columns for a 16+-field undeclared form when maximized, and three again when restored.
- The choice is a per-object preference (ui AGENTS.md #8): a new package-internal helper `modalMaximize.ts` stores `modal-form-maximized:OBJECT` in `localStorage` (try/catch, SSR-safe; restore removes the entry). It is re-read when a mounted dialog is handed another object. Not re-exported from `index.tsx` or `core.ts`.
- Phone: the sheet already fills the screen, so the switch is drawn from `sm` up only (`hidden sm:inline-flex`). The header gets `sm:pr-20` so a long title stays clear of the two buttons.
- Clause-② `no` holds: no new locale key (the two keys exist in every pack; only the no-provider English defaults table in `ModalForm` gains the two entries the drawer's table carries), no new export or prop on `@object-ui/plugin-form` or `@object-ui/components`, no spec key. `mobile-dialog-content.tsx` is untouched (the override merges over its base `sm:max-h-[90vh]`).
- Kept: #34599's close guard and sticky Save bar in the master-detail arm (pinned maximized: the discard prompt still fires on the X, `md-form-submit` still drawn); #34607's `dialogUndeclaredColumns`.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/modalMaximize-34604.test.tsx` (10 tests; no shared ModalForm harness file exists, so a card-named file):

- flat arm: label/aria and icon, order before Close, `sm`-only, same content node across toggles, restore gives back the previous width class; typed value and same input element across two toggles, then the X still opens "Discard changes?"; switch present with `modalCloseButton: false`.
- preference: reopen maximized for the same object, another object unaffected; restore forgets; a mounted dialog handed another object takes that object's choice; a throwing `Storage` leaves the switch working.
- columns: 16 undeclared fields read three per row at `@4xl` in the inferred `xl`, four maximized, three restored; the typed value survives.
- master-detail arm: switch present and toggles the same content node; header value and an added line (same input elements) survive two toggles, Save bar drawn, the X still prompts.

No existing pin changed (`dialogDefaultLayout-12521`, `modalViewportGutter-12593`, `modalCloseButton-11061`, `ObjectForm.mobileFullscreen` all pass unchanged).

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0; `--listFiles` of `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test file.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, restored, no permanent test files)</summary>

Both through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved, restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). The test imports `../ModalForm` from source, so no build sits on the path.

1. `if (maximized) return 'full';` replaced by a constant-false guard: 10 of 10 tests red.
2. `key={maximized ? 'max' : 'restored'}` added to the flat arm's content (a remount on toggle): the two flat-arm identity tests red ("expected the same dialog node", "expected the same input element"), 1 passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Before: the form dialog had no size control; the inferred size stops at `xl` and the height at `90vh`. After: the switch above, in both arms, remembered per object.
- Escape still runs the close guard while maximized (the drawer's Escape restores first); not asked by the card, left as is.
- An authored `modalSize: 'full'` still shows the switch: there maximize only lifts the height cap.
- ui AGENTS.md #2 (README / `content/docs/frontend`) was not updated: neither page describes the dialog's runtime chrome today and both are outside this card's file surface.
- #34642 landed first; merge `f85988ac` hand-resolved ModalForm.tsx and keeps both features (L1 ACCEPT 6942536762). `overlap-check` at 9b6b5b02: clean.
